definitions.false_birth_proxy: New delivered ID despite exactly one clean prior ACTIVE target; histories differ, not proof of Birth-head miscalibration.
definitions.NULL: Only paired where both methods have a unique clean active target for the same currently detected GT person.
definitions.mixed_ID: Cumulative clean labels; reuse may include the current correct person, not all mixed reuse is new wrong-person contamination.
definitions.gap: Matched-detection gap; GT absent intervals may be occlusion/out-of-view/annotation absence, not measured physical visibility.
definitions.global_graph: Posthoc whole-video Hungarian one-to-one overlap on clean matched detections, not CVIDF1.
definitions.appearance: Cosine of current frozen raw GMT ROI descriptors; low cosine is not a calibrated camera angle.
